response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(traitcount) AS feature_count FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), s AS (SELECT zoneref, feature_count, feature_count * 1.0 / SUM(feature_count) OVER () AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT zoneref, feature_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT zoneref AS site_code, feature_count, share, share - avg_share AS margin_above_average FROM a WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Share is a fraction (site total / overall total), not a percentage. The average share is the mean of the per-site shares, which equals 1 divided by the number of sites.
Only sites with at least one non-null traitcount are counted as sites. Rows with a null traitcount are excluded, so a site whose counts are all null does not enter the average.
